use the evidence-based capability status vocabulary instead of a blanket Stable label

forbiddenPublicText.pattern: ML-KEM 的标准化尚未关闭
forbiddenPublicText.message: ML-KEM is standardized; describe the actual implementation gap instead

forbiddenPublicText.pattern: 安全的(错误处理|引擎解析)版本|全面的 AES 启动自检|验证完整证书链

capabilities.label: Facade metadata and Contract errors
capabilities.summary: Facade metadata、ContractErrorCode、ContractException 与兼容映射。
capabilities.proof: metadata and outcome-construction tests
capabilities.limits: 兼容映射不应成为仓库身份；错误稳定性仍服从具体 API。

capabilities.label: Digest / HMAC / HKDF facade
capabilities.summary: SHA-256/384/512、HMAC、HKDF，以及遗留兼容 MD5/SHA-1。
capabilities.proof: digest vectors and boundary tests
capabilities.limits: MD5/SHA-1 仅兼容；无外部认证。

capabilities.label: ChaCha20 / Poly1305 facade
capabilities.summary: ChaCha20、Poly1305 与 AEAD facade。
capabilities.proof: RFC vectors, roundtrip and invalid-input tests
capabilities.limits: 无外部认证或跨平台加速承诺。

capabilities.label: X25519 facade
capabilities.summary: Key pair、公钥派生、key agreement request/result/outcome。
capabilities.proof: key agreement, cloning, invalid-input and all-zero tests
capabilities.limits: 继承 Core 的恒定时间非认证边界。

capabilities.label: X.509 / PEM / HTTP TLS material
capabilities.summary: 通用证书摘要、RSA/EC 密钥容器、证书链、pin 与 HTTP TLS 材料。
capabilities.proof: generic X.509/key-container, HTTP startup material and verified-session tests
capabilities.limits: 不是完整 WebPKI、原生系统信任库或浏览器级 HTTPS 证明。

capabilities.label: AES operations and backend readiness
capabilities.summary: AES ECB/CBC/CTR/GCM byte facade，以及 backend 探测、引擎选择和 readiness。
capabilities.proof: published block vector, GCM roundtrip/tamper, backend resolution and readiness tests
capabilities.limits: 不导出 native/context 类型；探测结果不是硬件加速认证或生产安全认证。

capabilities.label: System CSPRNG facade
capabilities.summary: Preferred Contract package 上的 fail-closed system CSPRNG bytes。
capabilities.proof: availability, output-size and invalid-size tests
capabilities.limits: 只描述当前宿主运行时 entropy backend；不提供可注入测试 RNG 或 DRBG 状态对象。

capabilities.label: SSH Contract protocol facade
capabilities.summary: KEX prelude、主机验证、Contract-owned 握手摘要、Bridge key adapter、启动 bundle 与包保护 channel。
capabilities.proof: RSA/ECDSA/Ed25519 startup, Contract-owned RSA host signing adapter, host verification and bidirectional channel tests
capabilities.limits: 调用方拥有 socket、认证、channel scheduling 与 rekey 策略；不声明外部互操作完成。

capabilities.label: Provider readiness and smoke gates
capabilities.summary: Provider capability、self-check、smoke、错误归一化与降级建议。
capabilities.proof: provider gate, self-check and smoke tests
capabilities.limits: 部分 smoke fixture 是 metadata/precheck 证明，不等同于 live network handshake。

capabilities.label: ECC / ECDSA / ECDH operations
capabilities.summary: P-256/P-384/P-521/secp256k1 byte-key DTO、message/pre-hashed ECDSA、ECDH 与 ES256 structured verify。
capabilities.proof: P-256 public derivation, message/pre-hashed sign/verify/tamper and two-party ECDH tests
capabilities.limits: 不导出 BigNum/raw points；不升级 Core 私钥路径的时序与认证边界。

capabilities.label: Ed25519 operations
capabilities.summary: Seed/keypair、公钥派生、签名与验证 byte facade。
capabilities.proof: RFC 8032 seed/public-key shape, sign/verify, tamper and full asymmetric regression tests
capabilities.limits: 继承 Core 私钥路径的时序非认证边界；不提供密钥托管。

capabilities.label: RSA operations
capabilities.summary: Byte-key DTO、key generation/import，以及 message-level PSS/PKCS#1 v1.5 sign/verify。
capabilities.proof: PKCS#8 import, PSS/PKCS#1 v1.5 sign/verify, SSH host signing adapter and tamper tests
capabilities.limits: 不公开 raw private transform 或 CRT internals；无恒定时间认证。

capabilities.label: GM primitives / SM2 / SM3 / SM4 / DRBG facade
capabilities.summary: SM3/HMAC/KDF、SM4 全模式/AEAD/MAC、SM2 密钥/签名/加密/协商与 GM DRBG 的 byte-only Contract facade。
capabilities.proof: published vectors, roundtrip, tamper, key-exchange confirmation and DRBG lifecycle tests
capabilities.limits: 纯仓颉运行时实现并继承 Core 的时序边界；不声明商密检测或监管认证。
readmeTokens: GM primitives / SM2 / SM3 / SM4 / DRBG facade

capabilities.label: SM9 identity-based crypto facade
capabilities.summary: SM9 KGC 主密钥、用户私钥、签名、身份加密、配对与认证密钥交换。
capabilities.proof: sign/verify, pairing, identity encryption, tamper rejection and confirmation tests
capabilities.limits: 公开面使用固定字节编码；不导出 Core 曲线点/配对类型，不声明外部互操作认证。

capabilities.label: GM X.509 / key-container facade
capabilities.summary: SM2 SEC1/PKCS#8/SPKI、CSR、根/叶证书签发、链验证与 CRL 生命周期。
capabilities.proof: container roundtrip, CSR identity, issuance, chain and revocation tests
capabilities.limits: 本地 PKI 构件，不等同完整 WebPKI、系统信任库或证书产品认证。

capabilities.label: RFC 8998 TLS 1.3 GM facade
capabilities.summary: curveSM2 key_share、SM4-GCM/CCM+SM3 套件、key schedule、Finished、record 与 SM2 CertificateVerify。
capabilities.proof: both-suite hello, secret, bidirectional record and role-bound CertificateVerify tests
capabilities.limits: 完成协议密码构件与本地双端回放；不声明公网 TLS 服务或外部栈互操作完成。

capabilities.label: TLCP / DTLCP protocol facade
capabilities.summary: TLCP hello、双证书、静态 ECC/ECDHE、CBC/GCM、Finished/record 与 DTLCP epoch/replay/fragment/flight。
capabilities.proof: dual-role certificate, four-suite family, tamper, replay, reassembly and retransmission tests
capabilities.limits: caller 仍拥有 transport、timer 与会话调度；无外部 openHiTLS live interoperability claim。

capabilities.label: Traditional RSA / ECDH KEM facade
capabilities.summary: RSA-KEM 与 P-256 ECDH-KEM encapsulate/decapsulate，以及明确的 ML-KEM provider gap。
capabilities.proof: RSA and ECDH KEM two-party roundtrip plus profile boundary tests
capabilities.limits: 传统 KEM 不具备后量子安全属性；当前没有 ML-KEM/hybrid PQC 实现。

capabilities.label: QUIC v1/v2 protection facade
capabilities.summary: Initial key derivation、显式 AEAD、Header Protection 与 Retry integrity。
capabilities.proof: RFC 9001 vectors, mismatch rejection, standalone consumer and full tests
capabilities.limits: 仅为 QUIC 密码/包保护接口；不声明 QUIC transport、HTTP/3 或网络互操作完成。

capabilities.label: TLS session cache and secure opaque resumption
capabilities.summary: 有限容量 cache、server-owned opaque ticket、binder validation、rotation 与 single-use consumption。
capabilities.proof: cache tests plus secure opaque-ticket roundtrip, replay, rotation, expiry and bad-input rejection
capabilities.limits: 单进程有界 owner；调用方负责串行访问，不声明持久化、跨进程 replay 协调、HelloRetryRequest 或 0-RTT。
readmeTokens: TLS session cache / secure opaque resumption

capabilities.label: TLS cipher-suite, PSK and safe wire contracts
capabilities.summary: Cipher suite、Contract-owned PSK/session DTO 与不暴露握手 secret 的 wire helper。
capabilities.proof: cipher-suite, PSK, server-handshake wire-helper and all-surface ownership tests
capabilities.limits: 原始 key/context/traffic-secret helper 为模块内部；完整 caller-owned transport runtime 位于 jinguissl.live。

capabilities.label: Incremental TLS 1.3 live runtime
capabilities.summary: Caller-owned transport 上的增量 client/server handshake、record 输入输出与 verified channels；服务端可显式允许未携带 ALPN 的 HTTP/1.1 回落。
capabilities.proof: incremental client/server, strict-default and explicit missing-ALPN HTTP/1.1 start, protected-flight, wire-derived and accepted-transport tests
capabilities.limits: 缺失 ALPN 的 HTTP/1.1 回落必须显式启用且不会伪造协商结果；调用方仍拥有 socket/transport；无浏览器级 HTTPS、外部 H2 或在线互操作完成声明。

capabilities.label: Runtime compatibility and startup profiles
capabilities.summary: Runtime marker、profile catalog 与公共 runtime surface。
capabilities.proof: runtime marker and startup-profile catalog tests
capabilities.limits: 描述当前运行时适配信息，不等于多平台运行证明。
